dialogue: There's a lot of stuff you'd expect.
Condiments and fast food leftovers, some items are labeled with names.
I remember her saying a while ago she was going on a diet.
Laurin protested, saying something about her body that probably would've sounded weird coming out of someone else's mouth.
But Laurin is too respectful and too fruity for it to come off that way.
Then she said it wasn't the losing weight kinda diet, the muscle building kind.
And that she had started going to the gym more often.
She had moved into a new apartment and realized that she could barely help in the moving process..
..one of her friends doing most of the heavy lifting.
That friend was a gym rat and Jess started going to the gym with her.
Though, I can't say I don't still think that.
